analysis.title: GS US TMT .. quick hits ..
key_insights: NDX closed down about 635 bps (6.35%) on 5 Nov 2026, now about 15% off its highs. Semis fell about 12%+ and are nearly 40% off their highs. Both indices posted their biggest 1-day drawdowns since March 2020 and are oversold on RSI.
Desk flows are skewed toward selling in Tech/AI with limited signs of defense anywhere. ETFs were about 32% of tape volume, their largest share since June, on a near-record ~27 bn shares day.
Options volume was the highest in market history, including a record number of puts.

The market is trying to price capex (gigawatt) builds over the next few years, more in 2028+ than 2027. Investor consensus on 2028+ datacenter builds is limited. SOX multiples have compressed by about 50% from the June/July highs.
The desk expects the next debate to be how much is already priced in and whether potential slowdowns are over-priced. The market has not taken comfort from real-time feedback during 3Q EPS season.

Sentiment is a very tough market. Bottoms-up datapoints remain strong (memory pricing, compute pricing, supply/demand visibility, 3Q earnings) but the top-down picture has gotten harder (policy and datacenter construction debates), creating tension in portfolio management as most AI/Tech names are compressed and oversold.
Top client inbounds were about Semis/AI flows, what is priced in for 2028+, why DASH is down so much, and where a bottom forms. The desk saw few 'shopping list' conversations.

Many AI and AI-adjacent stocks are now flat or down year to date, including CRDO, AMKR, AVGO, QCOM, NVDA, SNPS, SANM, SITM, CDNS, CAMT, CAT, TTMI, TEL, DY, LGN, FN, MTZ, IPGP, COHR, Neoclouds, IPPs, PLTR, MDB, AKAM, DT and ZS.

After-hours earnings: NET +15% on re-acceleration to +39% y/y (best growth in about 4 years). LRCX announced a ~$25bn buyback (about 10% of market cap). ABNB +10% on re-acceleration to +16% y/y room night growth. FROG +22% as Cloud revenue accelerated to +60% y/y from +53% last quarter.

ABNB said about 40% of customer support issues were resolved without a human agent in Q3 2026, up from a third in Q2. Support cost per booking fell more than 17% y/y, driven largely by its AI assistant.
October nonfarm payrolls are due the morning of 6 Nov. GS Economics estimates +75k vs consensus +65k and a three-month average of +51k, with average hourly earnings +0.3% m/m in line with consensus.
